prospectiveReconsideration.reason: Portainer is now a required retained OSS administration component, and no newer suitable CE LTS release is available. The founder authorized a fresh exact-version security and licensing assessment of CE 2.39.6, including a narrowly bounded source-controlled security overlay.
prospectiveReconsideration.historicalMeaning: F0-N4 remains immutable evidence of the earlier rejected feasibility image and the evidence available at that time. F0-N4R1 is a new prospective assessment and does not retroactively admit that image.

historicalEvidenceDisposition.disposition: The historical governance record and its recorded hashes remain evidence, but missing raw artifacts are not represented as independently reverified current admission inputs. F0-N4R1 generates fresh, separately digest-bound source, build, SBOM, vulnerability, provenance, reproducibility, license, and notice evidence.

officialImage.reason: The image source label revision is not bound to the public 2.39.6 tag revision. F0-N4R1 admits no substitution for the source-built downstream artifact.

downstreamSecurityOverlay.mobyGoArchiveGuard: Portainer has no direct import and the admitted Docker-only profile forbids the Compose.Copy and archive-extraction call surfaces.

vulnerability.genericFormatterDisposition: The exact 11 generator-, sealer-, or scanner-emitted JSON records enumerated by the F0-N4R1 test are excluded from Biome formatting only because rewrapping would invalidate their bound SHA-256 values; parsing, linting, locked hashes, and semantic validation remain mandatory.

reviewedNegativeSurfaceScan.semanticBoundary: Exact governance, build-tool, scanner, SBOM, license-custody, and vulnerability-evidence terminology does not introduce a retired customer-authoring route, authority, runtime, or surface. Rule/path entries, unique paths, counts, and fingerprints remain fail-closed in the repository guardrail.

securityDisposition.mediumFindingPolicy: Every retained Medium finding requires an exact compensating control, owner, re-review trigger, and expiry in the finding matrix.
activationPreconditions: Exact managed Docker Engine must be 29.7.0 or an exact admitted security backport.
Exact managed BuildKit must be 0.31.1 or later.
Docker authorization plugins and Docker Engine plugins must be absent.
Untrusted BuildKit frontends and untrusted Git subdirectory build contexts must be denied.
Kubernetes and Helm environments are outside the admitted Docker-only Core profile.
Every shipped Portainer frontend finding must be remediated or receive exact route and sink non-reachability qualification before activation.
F0-N4R2 must qualify Portainer's exact effective UID/GID, Docker authority, mounts, capabilities, security options, and root-equivalent appliance boundary before activation.
F0-N4R2 must bind and prove an exact credential-free Portainer health, restart, unhealthy-state, and recovery contract before activation.
Complete F0-N4R2 Core BOM, image lock, startup, persistence, recovery, backup, restart, and restore admission.
Complete F0-N4R3 Keycloak OAuth, Admin-only authorization, exact edge profile, coordinated logout, and no-bypass admission.
Complete F0-N4R4 Admin-only Console Technical Tools integration.
Complete F0-N4R5 runtime, browser, backup, restart, restore, retention, and aggregate security validation.

authenticationAndRoleEvidence.reason: F0-N4R1 is limited to exact source, build, vulnerability, provenance, reproducibility, and licensing admission. Runtime Generic OAuth, Keycloak SSO reuse, Admin mapping, Operator denial, recovery administration, native sessions, and logout are F0-N4R3 and F0-N4R5 gates.
